audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored for Trundle against a marksman whose own why-text says she pokes from outside Chomp range; Level 6 was scored for Trundle while its why says her roam beats your duel; 2+ items was scored for Quinn while three separate lines say the 1v1 finally flips to Trundle.
audit.why: Trundle sits at 50.94% over 53 games — a small sample and a near-even headline — but the shape is lopsided: she owns lane, he owns the late side lane. The old chart had all three swing stages pointing the wrong way and contradicting their own text.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Quinn / Skill / Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Trundle in both layers, with the why-text on levels 1, 2, 6, first item and 2+ items rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Trundle spike, but Behind Enemy Lines recasts on a 3-second cooldown and turns every recall into a roam.
audit.why: Her ultimate is a map-tempo spike, not a duel spike, so the level-6 marker had to change what it is measuring.
audit.corrected: Level 6 recast as her roam spike with the 3s recast named; the Trundle spike moved to 2+ items where Subjugate finally out-scales her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind was attributed to the wrong ability in three places — 'the blind from Heightened Senses passive', and the full layer labels the E as 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' and describes Vault as blinding. Blinding Assault is her Q (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range). Heightened Senses grants attack speed, move speed and a vision sweep. Vault dashes, slows and briefly interrupts. Chomp's sap was also called an attack-SPEED steal; Riot's text says Attack Damage.
audit.why: A Trundle who thinks the blind is on the dash will hold Chomp for the wrong cooldown and eat the blind on his engage every time.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault named as the Q with its cooldown, Heightened Senses described as her attack-speed and vision tool, Vault relabelled with its real 12s cooldown, and the sap corrected to attack damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault was treated as a free escape button she could use over your Pillar at will.
audit.why: Riot's Vault text is explicit: she dashes TO an enemy, then leaps off that enemy and lands near her maximum attack range from it. Her only escape from Trundle runs through touching Trundle — so the moment she lands on you she is inside Chomp's 300 range with no second exit for 12 seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[1], mid, and breakdown.cooldowns as the concrete all-in trigger: she vaults onto you, then you have the whole Vault cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'place Pillar between Quinn and her turret so her Vault sends her into terrain instead of to safety' asserts that Pillar of Ice blocks or redirects Vault's landing.
audit.why: Riot's text says only that she lands near her maximum attack range from the target; nothing available here says impassable terrain alters that landing. The old line reads as a reliable trick and is not verified.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verified version — Pillar goes on her landing spot after she has already vaulted, which needs no assumption about terrain interaction.

edits.before: Quinn's Harrier passive marks you on every auto and her E Vault instantly repositions her the moment you step forward, so her first two levels are almost untouchable.
edits.after: Harrier marks you periodically and her first auto on that mark carries bonus physical, while Vault (12s) repositions her the moment you step up — her first levels are untouchable.

edits.before: Quinn's Kraken Slayer or Galeforce first-item spike lets her shred through your Frozen Domain healing before Chomp's AS steal has a chance to matter.
edits.after: Quinn's Kraken Slayer or Galeforce first-item spike lets her shred through your Frozen Domain healing before Chomp's AD sap starts to matter.

edits.before: Draw W Frozen Domain onto yourself and bait her into chasing — the AS steal from Chomp compounds every second she stays inside the zone
edits.after: Drop Frozen Domain under yourself and bait the Vault out — every Chomp inside the zone saps her AD again on a 3.5s cooldown

edits.before: Use Vault to leap over Pillar and reset her kite angle so you never pin her inside Frozen Domain
edits.after: Vault off Trundle himself to land a full attack range away and reset the kite before Chomp lands

edits.before: Quinn's Harrier passive procs a marked bonus-damage auto every few seconds — at level 1 she fires poke autos from outside Chomp range before you ever close the gap.
edits.after: Harrier marks you periodically and her first auto on the mark carries bonus physical — she pokes from well outside Chomp's 300 range before you close.

edits.before: Vault comes online and she can leap backward over any Pillar you try to place reactively, resetting her kite angle with zero punishment.
edits.after: Vault (12s at rank 1) needs a target — she dashes onto you and leaps off, landing an attack range away, so she escapes by touching you first.

edits.before: With Q, W, and Vault all available she can auto-proc Harrier, Vault your engage, and blind you with Heightened Senses passive all in one fluid pattern — you have no safe all-in window.
edits.after: With all three basics up she procs Harrier, blinds your autos with Blinding Assault (11s), and Vaults off you to reset range — Heightened Senses is her attack speed, not the blind.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 she ranks up Harrier damage and gains crit synergy; Frozen Domain's move speed buff cannot close the gap before Vault puts her back at max range.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 rank Harrier's bonus damage; Frozen Domain's move speed still loses the race to Vault, down to 9s at rank 4 and landing her at max range.

edits.before: Quinn's Harrier passive is the reason this lane feels unfair from minute one — every third auto she throws procs a free bonus-damage mark, and her E Vault knocks you back the moment you step up to trade. Do not open with an aggressive Chomp unless you bait the Vault first: let her auto-auto into you, count the Harrier mark, and use Pillar preemptively on her retreat path so she lands in the ice rather than escaping cleanly. At level 2 she gains the blind from Heightened Senses passive and the Vault repositioning; your W Frozen Domain is largely wasted here because she will Vault out before you can stack the AS steal. Farm safely, keep the wave near your turret to deny her poke angles, and accept you are not winning this phase.
edits.after: Quinn's Harrier is why this lane feels unfair from minute one — Valor marks you periodically and her first auto on that mark carries bonus physical damage, while Vault (12s at rank 1) throws her back out the moment you step up to trade. Do not open with an aggressive Chomp unless you bait Vault first, and note the shape of it: she has to dash onto you to leave you, so her escape and her engage are the same button. Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) is where the blind actually lives — it turns your Chomp autos off, so bite in the beat after she has thrown it, not into it. Heightened Senses is her attack speed and her vision sweep. Farm safely, keep the wave near your turret to deny her poke angles, and accept this phase.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 Quinn owns the tempo war — she pokes from outside Chomp range, her passive keeps refreshing free damage, and Behind Enemy Lines at 6 means every trip to base is a roam threat you must ping. Your only leverage here is Pillar: place it between Quinn and her turret on a committed trade so her Vault sends her into terrain instead of to safety. If she ever over-steps the Harrier mark without Vault available, that is your all-in window — W down, Chomp the AS steal, chase through the ice and Pillar behind her. At 6 her roam is stronger than your duel power, so shove the wave before she hits 6 to force her to clear it rather than roam.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 Quinn owns the tempo war — she pokes from outside Chomp's 300 range, Harrier keeps refreshing free damage, and Behind Enemy Lines at 6 recasts on a 3-second cooldown, so every trip to base is a roam you have to ping. Your leverage is the Vault window: it is 12s at rank 1 and she has to dash onto you to use it, so the instant she lands on you she is inside Chomp range with no second exit. Drop Frozen Domain, bite, and Pillar her landing spot. If she throws Blinding Assault at the wave instead of at you, that is the same window. At 6 her roam beats your duel, so shove before she reaches it.

edits.before: Two completed items is when the lane finally tilts back your way. Subjugate does drain Quinn's resists, and while she is not a tank, the first cast still dumps a meaningful chunk of armor onto you, and Frozen Domain turns every extended fight into a losing proposition for her. Bait the Vault — she will always Vault when Subjugate lands — then Pillar on her landing spot immediately so she cannot re-establish kite distance. From there Chomp chains keep her attack speed in the dirt, your W healing out-sustains her burst window, and she runs out of damage before you do. In team fights peel toward your carries with Pillar rather than diving Quinn; save Subjugate for the enemy tank to maximize its resistance-drain payoff.
edits.after: Two completed items is when the lane finally tilts back your way. Subjugate does drain Quinn's resists, and while she is not a tank, the first cast still dumps a meaningful chunk of armor onto you, and Frozen Domain turns every extended fight into a losing proposition for her. Bait the Vault — she will spend it the moment Subjugate lands — then Pillar her landing spot immediately so she cannot re-establish kite distance. From there Chomp chains sap her attack damage every 3.5 seconds, your W healing out-sustains her burst window, and she runs out of damage before you do. In team fights peel toward your carries with Pillar rather than diving Quinn; save Subjugate for the enemy tank to maximize its resistance-drain payoff.

edits.before: She pokes + blinds + kites your W — pillar her early, or roam. Trundle wins by trading around Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind) and cashing the pattern: pillar her early, or roam for value.
edits.after: She pokes, blinds with Blinding Assault, and kites your W — pillar her, or roam. Trundle wins by trading around Vault (12s at rank 1): she has to vault onto you to get away from you.

edits.before: Pillar her early, or roam for value. Track Vault (Dash/Blind) before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Pillar her early, or roam for value. Track Vault (12s at rank 1) before every commit and hold the wave on your side.

edits.before: Quinn wins by landing Vault (Dash/Blind), denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Quinn wins by blinding your Chomp autos, kiting off Vault, and out-trading your engage windows.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind): matchup-defining — Her self-peel. Pillar her when down. Track it before every engage. - Quinn Vault: Dashes to a target, knocks back, and blinds their next attacks. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Blinding Assault (Q): 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range. The blind lives here, not on Vault, and your Chomp autos are what it turns off. - Vault (E): 12/11/10/9/8s. She dashes onto you to get away from you.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Vault (Dash/Blind): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Vault (12s at rank 1): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: Chomp start — bite Quinn on every last-hit attempt. The flat damage plus AD steal wins almost every level-1 exchange.
edits.after: Harrier marks you and her first auto on it hits hard — she pokes from outside Chomp's 300 range. Farm it out, do not chase.

edits.before: W down at your feet turns short trades your way: move speed, attack speed, and healing on your own terrain. Trade only inside the zone.
edits.after: Frozen Domain's move speed on your own terrain is the only way you ever touch her, so trade inside the zone or not at all.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Quinn to deny disengage, or between you and Vault (Dash/Blind) to break her pattern.
edits.after: Blinding Assault (11s) lands at 3 and your autos are the trade — bite in the beat after it, then Pillar her landing spot.

edits.before: Subjugate online — the 1v1 is yours into almost anyone the moment Quinn commits. R early in the all-in so the drained resists count for the whole fight.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines recasts on a 3-second cooldown, so every recall is a roam. Your Subjugate spike means nothing if she cashes hers elsewhere.

edits.before: Trinity Force is the duel spike — Spellblade procs off every Chomp. Force Quinn to answer you in the side lane.
edits.after: Her first item outruns Frozen Domain's healing — she commits and is gone before Subjugate's 4 seconds resolve.

edits.before: With two items you out-duel Quinn whenever R is up. The only loss condition left is fighting with Subjugate down — track it like she tracks Vault (Dash/Blind).
edits.after: With two items you out-duel Quinn whenever Subjugate is up. The only loss condition left is fighting with it down — track your own R like she tracks Vault.

notes: Unverified, left out rather than guessed: whether Pillar of Ice's terrain blocks or shortens Vault's landing, and whether Behind Enemy Lines is cancelled by damage or CC (Riot's text mentions neither). Small sample warning worth surfacing to the user: this matchup is only 53 games, so the 50.94% headline is soft — the chart was set from the kit logic and the packet's stage read, not from the win rate. The suspect-name flag on whys[3] ('Frozen Domain's') is a false positive; Frozen Domain is the correct name.
